title: cerastium quaternellum var. octandrum
intro: Cerastium quaternellum var. octandrum, commonly known as snow-in-summer, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium quaternellum var. octandrum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic actions, which may help alleviate various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
